biography.value: Storm Titans are Agil 8 — they act before almost everything they face and maintain that advantage through their entire engagement. Cyclone Aura at Hard task difficulty continuously displaces enemies regardless of how many actions they spend trying to hold position. Skyfire Bolt handles grouped formations at 150 feet. World Storm Fist's discharge damage at Margin 2 and 3 means the area around the primary target takes significant lightning damage as well. A summoner who keeps clear of the Cyclone Aura radius and lets the Storm Titan work will find most engagements resolved decisively and quickly.

system.attacksNotes:
World Storm Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (8 + 6 Str) + 4 lightning damage (Half DR); target pushed 20 feet + Prone; no save.
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 lightning damage; pushed 20 feet + Prone + Stunned until end of their next turn; all creatures within 15 feet of target take 10 lightning damage from discharge.
  • Margin 3: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 lightning damage + Prone + Stunned; area discharge increases to 16 lightning damage; all affected creatures also Deafened for 1 minute.

Skyfire Bolt [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 150 ft, 15-foot diameter.

  • Margin 1:: 18 lightning damage (15 + 3 Dex) + Dazed.
  • Margin 2: 18 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 18 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned + Prone; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Cyclone Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 20 feet make a Fortitude [Hard] save or pushed 20 feet directly away and knocked Prone. Ranged ### Attacks through the aura add 2 to both dice. Lightning Immunity Sharing: The summoner and up to 3 designated allies gain immunity to non-magical lightning damage within 60 feet. Powerful Build: The Storm Titan counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Momentum: When the Storm Titan moves at least 20 feet before making a melee attack, subtract 1 from both attack dice on that attack Intimidating Presence: As a [Combat] action all creatures within 40 feet that can hear it make a Will [Hard] save. On failure: target gains the Frightened condition for 1 minute. Creatures immune to fear are unaffected. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Storm Titan fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
